query.title: Search phrase
query.description: Exact phrase to search across full text of SEC filings, e.g. "supply chain disruption" or a company name.

forms.title: Form types
forms.description: Optional filing form filters, e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1, 4, 13F-HR.

startDate.title: Filed on or after
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for no lower bound.

endDate.title: Filed on or before
endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for no upper bound.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many filing records (you are charged per result).

sinceLastRun.title: Only new filings since last run
sinceLastRun.description: Incremental mode: remembers the newest filing date per query and only returns newer filings on the next run. Ideal for scheduled monitoring.
